description: Spectral 'mean' of two sounds, mode 3: channel amplitudes come FROM FILE 1 while pitches are averaged (pitchwise) between the two files - the hybrid pitch of mode 1 wearing file 1's dynamic envelope and spectral weighting. Verified distinct from mode 1 on the same input pair, with the same flag set (-l/-h live: -l300 -h5000 render differs from flag-less). Output duration = the SHORTER input (1.5209 from the (2.023, 1.521) pair, both orders). Deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: SoundThread's 'Mean Pitch': use it when you want the in-between pitch world of combine mean but file 1's identity to lead - the amplitude contour, attack shading and channel weighting stay with the first source, so the result reads as 'file 1 bent toward file 2' rather than an even-handed hybrid. Practical recipe: put the rhythmically/dynamically interesting source first and the pitch donor second. lofrq/hifrq restrict which register is averaged; zero_outside silences everything else for an isolated hybrid band. The amp-from-file2 mirror (mode 5) and the frqwise variants are execute()-reachable.

lofrq.description: Low frequency limit of channels to average - same CDP-enforced analysis-dependent range as mode 1 ('(5.000000 to 22028.466797)' quoted). Scalar only (family refusal 'brkpnt_files not permitted', parameter 1).

hifrq.description: High frequency limit of channels to average (analysis-dependent floor, '(48.066406 to 22050.000000)' quoted in mode 1). Scalar only.

chans.description: Number of significant channels to compare (default: all within range; CDP-enforced 2 to the analysis channel count, '(2.000000 to 513.000000)' quoted in mode 1).

zero_outside.description: Zero channels OUTSIDE the lofrq/hifrq range (default: pass through unaveraged).

examples.description: File 1's envelope carrying the averaged pitch of both sources.
examples.expected_use: Put the gesture/dynamics source first, the pitch donor second.

known_issues: Output duration = the SHORTER input (verified both orders).
Modes 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 verified running and pairwise-distinct - not curated (execute()); SoundThread covers exactly modes 1 and 3.
